dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト), API linkage module for inpatient accounting registration (入院会計登録), compiled with GnuCOBOL on Linux

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software — inpatient accounting API module handling room-charge differentials, meal deductions, and credit account registration via XML API
purpose.summary: This program is an API linkage subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that processes inpatient accounting registration requests. It reads XML input (HSACCTMREQ), validates fields such as patient number, admission date, treatment date, and request type, then dispatches to sub-sections for external hospitalization (外泊), room-charge differential (差額), meal (食事), and credit account (クレジット精算) processing. Results are returned via XML response area.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (34 copybooks) for JMA ORCA framework
XML read/write areas via copybooks (CPHSACCTMV2REQ.INC, CPHSACCTMV2RES.INC)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary ORCA middleware CALLs
OCCURS clauses for multi-occurrence API fields
EVALUATE on request number to dispatch processing type
Large comment ratio (30%) with Japanese Shift-JIS encoded comments decoded as latin-1
verdict.notes: Japanese text in comments is encoded in Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake in the archived form. Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is ~77KB/1986 lines. No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations — likely uses display numeric fields throughout. File is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project.
